+"""Helpers for working with numeric strings."""
+
+
+def is_integer(text: str) -> bool:
+    """Return True if text parses as an integer, optionally signed."""
+    try:
+        int(text)
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def digit_sum(text: str) -> int:
+    """Return the sum of the decimal digits found in text."""
+    return sum(int(ch) for ch in text if ch.isdigit())
